long_biography.plain_text:
George Argyros entered Orange County real estate after working in grocery stores and earning securities, insurance and property licences. He opened a brokerage in 1963, then established the company that became Arnel & Affiliates five years later. Buying corner sites for resale to petrol stations gave way to retaining apartment and commercial assets under long-term private ownership.

Arnel developed and manages apartment communities alongside office, retail and industrial properties across Southern California. Argyros remains chairman and chief executive, combining direct property operations with private-equity investing through Westar Capital. He also owned the Seattle Mariners for nine seasons and spent 25 years chairing Chapman University's trustees, helping oversee the creation of its law and film schools.
